statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The procedure is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect asymptomatic or symptomatic atrial fibrillation episodes that may require anticoagulation management
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary
